052
053        public void addIcons(IconGroupAPI iconGroup) {
054                CommodityIconCounts counts = new CommodityIconCounts(com);
055                
056                int deficit = counts.deficit;
057                int available = Math.max(0, counts.available - counts.extra);
058                int extra = counts.extra;
059                
060                if (available > 0) {
061                        iconGroup.addIconGroup(Commodities.SHIP_WEAPONS, IconRenderMode.NORMAL, available, null);
062                }
063                if (deficit > 0) {
064                        iconGroup.addIconGroup(Commodities.SHIP_WEAPONS, IconRenderMode.RED, deficit, null);
065                }
066                if (extra > 0) {
067                        iconGroup.addIconGroup(Commodities.SHIP_WEAPONS, IconRenderMode.GREEN, extra, null);
068                }
069        }

083        public RaidDangerLevel getDangerLevel() {
084                RaidDangerLevel danger = getWeaponsCommoditySpec().getBaseDanger();
085                
086                CommodityIconCounts counts = new CommodityIconCounts(com);
087                if (counts.production >= counts.available) {
088                        danger = danger.prev();
089                }
090                if (counts.deficit > 0) {
091                        return danger.next();
092                }
093                if (counts.extra > 0) {
094                        return danger.prev();
095                }
096                
097                if (source != null) {
098                        danger = source.adjustCommodityDangerLevel(id, danger);
099                }
100                
101                return danger;
102        }

135        public float getBaseRaidValue() {
136                CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(id);
137                float unit = 1f;
138                
139                CommodityIconCounts counts = new CommodityIconCounts(com);
140                
141                float result = 0f;
142                
143                result += Math.max(0, counts.available - counts.extra) * unit * VALUE_NORMAL;
144                result += counts.extra * unit * VALUE_EXCESS;
145                result += counts.deficit * unit * VALUE_DEFICIT;
146                
147                result *= VALUE_OVERALL;
148                
149                if (result < 0) result = 0;
150                
151                return result;
152        }

168        
169        protected float getQMult(int tier) {
170                if (tier <= 0) return 0f;
171                if (tier <= 1) return 0.25f;
172                if (tier <= 2) return 0.5f;
173                return 0.75f;
174        }
175        
176        public int performRaid(CargoAPI loot, Random random, float lootMult, TextPanelAPI text) {
177                if (marinesAssigned <= 0) return 0;
178                
179                //random = new Random();
180                
181                WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI> pickerW = new WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI>(random);
182                WeightedRandomPicker<FighterWingSpecAPI> pickerF = new WeightedRandomPicker<FighterWingSpecAPI>(random);
183                WeightedRandomPicker<HullModSpecAPI> pickerH = new WeightedRandomPicker<HullModSpecAPI>(random);
184                
185                WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI> weaponSubset = new WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSpecAPI>(random);
186                WeightedRandomPicker<FighterWingSpecAPI> fighterSubset = new WeightedRandomPicker<FighterWingSpecAPI>(random);
187
188                String factionId = market.getFactionId();
189                float quality = Misc.getShipQuality(market, factionId);
190                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(factionId);
191                
192                int maxTier = 0;
193                if (market.getSize() >= 6) {
194                        maxTier = 1;
195                }
196                if (Misc.hasHeavyIndustry(market) || Misc.isMilitary(market)) {
197                        maxTier = 1000;
198                }
199                
200                float numSmall = 0;
201                float numMedium = 0;
202                float numLarge = 0;
203                for (String id : faction.getKnownWeapons()) {
204                        WeaponSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getWeaponSpec(id);
205                        switch (spec.getSize()) {
206                        case LARGE:
207                                numLarge++;
208                                break;
209                        case MEDIUM:
210                                numMedium++;
211                                break;
212                        case SMALL:
213                                numSmall++;
214                                break;
215                        }
216                }
217                float numTotal = numSmall + numMedium + numLarge + 1f;
218                        
219                for (String id : faction.getKnownWeapons()) {
220                        WeaponSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getWeaponSpec(id);
221                        if (spec.getAIHints().contains(AIHints.SYSTEM)) continue;
222                        if (spec.getTier() > maxTier) continue;
223                        
224                        float p = 1f * spec.getRarity() + quality * getQMult(spec.getTier());
225                        switch (spec.getSize()) {
226                        case LARGE:
227                                p *= 1f - numLarge / numTotal;
228                                p *= 2f;
229                                break;
230                        case MEDIUM:
231                                p *= 1f - numMedium / numTotal;
232                                p *= 3f;
233                                break;
234                        case SMALL:
235                                p *= 1f - numSmall / numTotal;
236                                p *= 4f;
237                                break;
238                        }
239                        pickerW.add(spec, p);
240                }
241                for (int i = 0; i < 4 + marinesAssigned; i++) {
242                        WeaponSpecAPI spec = pickerW.pick();
243                        if (spec != null) {
244                                float w = pickerW.getWeight(spec);
245                                weaponSubset.add(spec, w);
246                                pickerW.remove(spec);
247                        }
248                }
249                
250                for (String id : faction.getKnownFighters()) {
251                        FighterWingSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getFighterWingSpec(id);
252                        if (spec.getTier() > maxTier) continue;
253                        
254                        float p = 1f * spec.getRarity() + quality * getQMult(spec.getTier());
255                        pickerF.add(spec, p);
256                }
257                for (int i = 0; i < 2 + marinesAssigned/2; i++) {
258                        FighterWingSpecAPI spec = pickerF.pick();
259                        if (spec != null) {
260                                float w = pickerF.getWeight(spec);
261                                fighterSubset.add(spec, w);
262                                pickerF.remove(spec);
263                        }
264                }
265                
266                for (String id : faction.getKnownHullMods()) {
267                        HullModSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(id);
268                        if (spec.isHidden()) continue;
269                        if (spec.isAlwaysUnlocked()) continue;
270                        if (spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_DROP)) continue;
271                        if (spec.getTier() > maxTier) continue;
272                        
273                        float p = 1f * spec.getRarity();
274                        if (Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().knowsHullMod(id)) {
275                                p *= 0.2f;
276                        }
277                        pickerH.add(spec, p);
278                }
279                
280                
281                float targetValue = getQuantity(marinesAssigned);
282                targetValue *= lootMult;
283                float mult = 0.9f + random.nextFloat() * 0.2f;
284                targetValue *= mult;
285                
286                quantityLooted = (int) targetValue;
287                
288                float weaponWeight = faction.getDoctrine().getWarships() + faction.getDoctrine().getPhaseShips();
289                float fighterWeight = 1f + faction.getDoctrine().getCarriers();
290                float hullmodWeight = 1f + quality * 1f;
291                float totalWeight = weaponWeight + fighterWeight + hullmodWeight;
292                
293                float weaponValue = targetValue * weaponWeight / totalWeight;
294                float fighterValue = targetValue * fighterWeight / totalWeight;
295                float hullmodValue = targetValue * hullmodWeight / totalWeight;
296
297                float totalValue = 0;
298                
299                looted.clear();
300                
301                //float wepMult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_weaponSellPriceMult") : 1f;
302                float wepMult = 1f; // baked into base price already
303                
304                int tries = 0;
305                while (weaponValue > 0 && tries < 100) {
306                        tries++;
307                        WeaponSpecAPI weapon = weaponSubset.pick();
308                        if (weapon != null) {
309                                int min = 1, max = 2;
310                                // don't do this since the odds of rolling large are smaller than medium smaller than small etc
311//                              switch (weapon.getSize()) {
312//                              case LARGE: min = 1; max = 2; break;
313//                              case MEDIUM: min = 1; max = 4; break;
314//                              case SMALL: min = 2; max = 6; break;
315//                              }
316                                float val = weapon.getBaseValue() * SELL_MULT * wepMult;
317                                int num = min + random.nextInt(max - min + 1);
318                                num = (int) Math.min(num, weaponValue / val);
319                                if (num == 0) {
320                                        if (random.nextFloat() < weaponValue / val) num = 1;
321                                }
322                                if (num > 0) {
323                                        looted.addWeapons(weapon.getWeaponId(), num);
324                                        weaponValue -= val * num;
325                                        totalValue += val * num;
326                                } else {
327                                        break;
328                                }
329                        } else {
330                                break;
331                        }
332                }
333                
334                fighterValue += Math.max(0, weaponValue);
335                
336                tries = 0;
337                while (fighterValue > 0 && tries < 100) {
338                        tries++;
339                        FighterWingSpecAPI fighter = fighterSubset.pick();
340                        if (fighter != null) {
341                                int min = 1, max = 2;
342                                switch (fighter.getRole()) {
343                                case ASSAULT:
344                                case BOMBER:
345                                case SUPPORT:
346                                        min = 1; max = 2;
347                                        break;
348                                case FIGHTER:
349                                        min = 1; max = 3;
350                                        break;
351                                case INTERCEPTOR:
352                                        min = 1; max = 4;
353                                        break;
354                                }
355                                float val = fighter.getBaseValue() * SELL_MULT * wepMult;
356                                int num = min + random.nextInt(max - min + 1);
357                                num = (int) Math.min(num, fighterValue / val);
358                                if (num == 0) {
359                                        if (random.nextFloat() < fighterValue / val) num = 1;
360                                }
361                                if (num > 0) {
362                                        looted.addFighters(fighter.getId(), num);
363                                        fighterValue -= val * num;
364                                        totalValue += val * num;
365                                } else {
366                                        break;
367                                }
368                        } else {
369                                break;
370                        }
371                }
372                
373                hullmodValue += Math.max(0, fighterValue);
374
375                tries = 0;
376                while (hullmodValue > 0 && tries < 100) {
377                        tries++;
378                        HullModSpecAPI mod = pickerH.pickAndRemove();
379                        if (mod != null) {
380                                float val = mod.getBaseValue();
381                                int num = 0;
382                                if (random.nextFloat() < hullmodValue / val) num = 1;
383                                if (num > 0) {
384                                        looted.addHullmods(mod.getId(), num);
385                                        hullmodValue -= val * num;
386                                        totalValue += val * num;
387                                } else {
388                                        break;
389                                }
390                        } else {
391                                break;
392                        }
393                }
394                
395                loot.addAll(looted);
396                
397                xpGained = (int) (totalValue * XP_GAIN_VALUE_MULT);
398                return xpGained;
399        }
